definition: This dimension controls the range and types of materials available for crafting, influencing the complexity and variety of items players can create. It varies by the number of distinct materials, their sources, and how they interact with each other in recipes.
exclusion_criteria: Limited material types with no variations
Crafting systems that rely solely on a single material or item
inclusion_criteria: Variety of raw materials available to players
Different categories of materials (e.g., metals, herbs, fabrics)
title: Material Diversity in Crafting Systems
